_about: The certificate of citizenship (N-600) packet (src/packet.py, src/certificate.py), per the N-600 Instructions (01/20/25): the G-28 and the N-600, the client's birth certificate (with translation), proof the parent is a U.S. citizen, the green card (INA 320), the parents' marriage certificate and any divorce decrees, and proof of the citizen parent's legal custody. No photos for a child living in the U.S. (uscis.gov/n-600). The attorney approves titles and order.
title: N-600 application (certificate of citizenship)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: No photos for a client living in the U.S. (USCIS takes them at the biometrics appointment); two passport-style photos only for a client living abroad.

exhibits.title: The client's birth certificate (with certified English translation)
Proof the parent is a U.S. citizen (U.S. birth certificate, passport, naturalization or citizenship certificate)
The client's Permanent Resident Card (front and back)
The parents' marriage certificate, and any divorce decrees
Custody: proof the client lived in the citizen parent's legal and physical custody (custody order, school or lease records)
